name: The Painter VR
summary:
The Painter VR turns your Meta Quest into an art studio in the sky. No experience needed: pick up a brush and start painting.

REAL TOOLS IN YOUR HANDS
Seven tools, each with its own feel: round, detail, flat, large, filbert and fan brushes, plus a palette knife for thick paint. Load your brush from the paint wells, mix colours and watch the tip take on the colour you are carrying.

THE ART ACADEMY
15 classes built around five subjects (ball, star, heart, crescent moon and cube), each in three levels: Basic
